correctness.rationale: On the pairwise-identical strain-parameter subspace, let r=μ_L+δ, τ=Σω_j, s=exp(−Σα_jω_j)>0 and K=rμ_Iμ_V/(sδθ). The equilibrium stage-chain balances with viral concentration v>0 cancel v to give γH/(1+ψv)=K, while the H equation gives φ−η_HH−K(C+B)=0. If ψ=0, H=K/γ and every C+B=T=(φγ−η_HK)/(γK)>0, including two endpoints, solves all seven equations under R=φγ/(η_H K)>1; if ψ>0 both positive strains force C=B=vψ=(φγ−η_HK)/[K(2γ+η_Hψ)] and H=K(1+ψvψ)/γ, giving unique strict coexistence. Antisymmetric perturbations u=L−E,w=Y−Z,z=C−B have zero H tangent and form a 3-stage linear retarded block; eliminating gives (λ+r)(λ+μ_I)(λ+μ_V)−rμ_Iμ_V exp(−λτ)/(1+ψvψ)=0. For real x>−min rates, the polynomial product increases, delayed term decreases, and real F(x) has one simple zero λψ in (−min,0], λ0=0. Modulus of every complex root gives Re λ≤λψ, with equality only for real root. ψvψ is strictly increasing, so λψ strictly decreases. Implicit-function derivative at ψ=0 yields λψ=−rμ_Iμ_Vv0 ψ/[rμ_I+rμ_V+μ_Iμ_V+rμ_Iμ_V τ]+O(ψ²). This proves only the antisymmetric *linear* decay scale ~ψ^(−1), not nonlinear global stability; zero-delay boundaries included.

value.rationale: The delayed seven-compartment two-virus model is a natural published competition system, and its degenerate identical-strain limit exposes a genuine neutral equilibrium manifold. Exact saturation selection and an all-delay leading real exchange root with explicit singular weak-saturation damping coefficient quantify an otherwise missing slow mode. This is a motivated parameter-boundary statement in an existing model, not merely checking that a known equilibrium satisfies the equations.

scientific_limitations: Exact parameter symmetry, R>1, ψ≥0, finite nonnegative delays; endpoints of neutral segment are one-strain equilibria.
Dominant *antisymmetric* linear root only; not overall spectral gap, basin geometry, nonlinear rate or small mismatch perturbations.
